settings.title: Coordinates to Geometry
settings.description: Choose an entity type and which of its attributes a WKT attribute is calculated from. The WKT attribute becomes read-only for this entity type.
settings.overwrite_hint: Saving recalculates the WKT values of all entities of this type and replaces existing values. Entities with missing or invalid coordinates lose their WKT value.
settings.no_permission: You do not have the permission to change the coordinate settings.
settings.none: No WKT attribute is calculated yet.
